name: the Commons' tontine under the whole constitution -- sentence-level cases for Haro v0.26 (ZC5), the ones the author reads
comment: Written BEFORE z_v26.haro and before tontine.z gained its holder (the W discipline). Each case runs the court forged from z_v26.haro on rnxc AND on the oracle; the two must print the same bytes. The shapes are v0.25's (first, contains, counts, diagnose, record, sequence, revert). tontine/ holds the tontine as zing's fixture wrote it (unheld), three sentences each breaking one rule, a destructive verb, and four proposals: a knob turned by the collector's app, a holder and a rule a model proposes, the words of a refusal a model proposes. Corrected once after the court spoke (HF-130): T8 and T10 were written citing the constraint's NAME (rule:a_formula_names_its_field), the form the court uses when no CODE is declared; with a CODE declared it cites the code (rule:NO_COMPUTE), as v0.11 ruled and as T5 and T7 already expected of a seat -- the fixture was wrong, the court right, the substance (the constraint's own code in the envelope) unchanged.

cases.name: the held tontine is a sentence of Z: its counts are zing's, plus nothing
the meta-court reads Z's declaration: all six articles, the landing zone as the zone, both weaves constitutional, Niger Law 2017-28 as the regime, five points
Z's previous declaration (v0.16) is still accepted unchanged: the constitution is a world's choice, not a demand on every world
Art. 5, the one line the constitution adds to the tontine: as zing's fixture wrote it, nobody holds the landing zone -- refused, the article named
contains: HELD_BY is required on LANDING_ZONE cotisations

cases.name: the same refusal in the envelope: the seat's code, the rule and the article cited
Art. 5: a landing zone whose records enter through a flow nobody declared -- refused in the zone's own words, the article named
contains: LANDING_ZONE enquetes lands INTO 'sondage', and no FLOW of that name is declared

cases.name: the same in the envelope: NO_FLOW, the rule and the article cited
Art. 1: a step with a FORMULA and no COMPUTE is refused in Z's words, and the envelope carries the constraint's own CODE, not the generic one
Art. 1: two steps at one rank of collect -- refused with the constraint's words and its CODE
contains: STEP record_again and STEP record both stand at ORDER 1 of collect: one rank, one step

cases.name: the same in the envelope: ONE_RANK
zing's own first law, unchanged under the constitution: DROP is not forbidden, it is unparseable -- and now carries the declared CODE
Art. 3 through the voice: every kind of the tontine told in Z's own words -- the enum's words, the entity's fields, the norms' rules, the flows, the steps and who acts, the zone and who holds it
contains: deposit_status is one of staged, audited, active.
deposit is a record of id -> uuid, member -> text, amount -> currency, round -> int, status -> deposit_status.
positive_deposit holds amount > 0; broken, it says: A deposit must bring something to the circle.
collect is a flow records walk.
record is step 1 of collect, acted by collector.
calcul is step 2 of indice, acted by system.
cotisations is held by the_commons; json records land in it and walk collect.

cases.name: Art. 2 and 6: the collector's app turns the zone's format, a knob floored external -- admitted, and the inverse restores the sentence byte for byte

Art. 4 and 6 at the sentence: a model proposes a new holder for the zone and a looser rule for the norm -- both refused at the trust stage, Art. 6 named; the same model proposes new words for the norm's message -- admitted, a message being a field floored llm; the chain keeps all three, Art. 3
contains: below the required floor :trusted for 'cotisations.HELD_BY' [Art. 6 trust_hierarchy]
below the required floor :trusted for 'positive_deposit.RULE' [Art. 6 trust_hierarchy]
admitted: positive_deposit.MESSAGE A deposit must bring something to the circle -> A deposit brings something to the circle, or it is not a deposit [llm]
